description: A plugin module for parsing and processing challenge questions with video solutions in a markdown AST, including extracting questions, answers, feedback, and audio IDs.

methods.name: plugin
methods.description: Main function returning the transformer function for processing markdown AST.

methods.name: transformer
methods.description: Processes the AST to extract questions, answers, feedback, and video solutions, and attaches them to the file data.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Constructs a question object from text, answers, and solution nodes, validating presence and correctness.

methods.name: getAnswers
methods.description: Extracts answer options, feedback, and audio IDs from answer nodes, handling multiple feedback sections and ordering.

methods.name: getSolution
methods.description: Parses and validates the video solution number from solution nodes.
